Physical properties: Rheometer (HAAKE MARS 40)
equipment
Institute of Materials Research and Engineering (IMRE)
2 Fusionopolis Way, Innovis, #08-03 Singapore 138634
What is it? 
Rheometer
Manufacturer: Thermo Scientific
Model Name: HAAKE MARS 40 Rheometer
Applications: Application-specific accessories and workflows for polymers, petrochemical, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, paints, inks, coatings, food, construction and building materials
Instrument Overview: NA
Technical features and specifications: 
HAAKE MARS next generation rheometers offer: Future Orientation State-of-the-art rheometer platform Broad range of accessories to handle new analytical requirements, including the Thermo Scientific™ RheoScope module for micro viewing and Thermo Scientific™ HAAKE™ Rheonaut module for FTIR analysis Integrated Web server to monitor data online Complements the Thermo Scientific™ HAAKE™ Viscotester™ iQ rheometer to easily transfer methods from R&D to QC Accuracy 1-piece frame with optimized force balance and stability Nano torque performance for sensitive samples – robust enough for daily use Ease-of-Use Connect Assist for geometries and temperature modules with quick-fit coupling and immediate recognition, plus automatic push-button rotor release Multi-lingual Thermo Scientific™ HAAKE™ RheoWin™ software fully automates measuring, evaluation routines for professionals and beginners Modularity Open system architecture accepts a broad range of temperature and measuring geometries to enhance accuracy and measuring abilities Two-column design with high flexibility for customization
Charges:
NA
